subject: maths
question:
Match the following types of lines with their correct descriptions according to their orientation and characteristics.

Description

A. A line that is neither parallel to a horizontal plane nor perpendicular to it.

B. A line that is perpendicular to horizontal lines.

C. A line that changes its direction continuously.

D. A line that is parallel to a horizontal plane.
solution:
The correct answer is __Option 4__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A line that is neither parallel to a horizontal plane nor perpendicular to it__ is matched with A - 3.
 
• __A line that is perpendicular to horizontal lines__ is matched with B - 2.
 
• __A line that changes its direction continuously__ is matched with C - 4.
 
• __A line that is parallel to a horizontal plane__ is matched with D - 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Types of Lines:**

 
 
• Lines can be categorized based on their orientation and characteristics.
 
• Key types include horizontal, vertical, inclined, and curved lines.
 
 
 
• **Applications:**
 
 
• Understanding line characteristics is crucial in engineering, architecture, and technical drawing.
 
• It also helps in interpreting graphs and geometric figures.
